momentum.clock: ohlc window, first close to last close

spread.clock: latest public bid/ask print, not an OHLC bar
spread.definition: (ask - bid) / ((ask + bid) / 2) of the latest print

volatility.definition: mean of (high - low) / ((high + low) / 2) over the closed bars

volume.definition: last bar base volume / max base volume in the closed window

spread_time_range.note: This is the venue's recent spread window, not a print for every OHLC bar.

time_range.clock: ohlc bar open time; end is the last kept bar open time plus the interval
